cases.proof: SKILL.md requires inspect before run or ensure-run.
An arbitrary cwd remained separate from the explicit target and external cache.
Missing SDK reported the bundled package, version, path, SHA-256, target, cache, and no-network source.
The bundle declared an operator-approved plugin-distribution root, integrity-only assurance, and publisher authenticity NOT_VERIFIED_BY_BOOTSTRAP.
Install returned approval_required and created no install tree.
Approved SHA-pinned tarball installation resolved ready with v3 provenance, a named local-tarball trust anchor, and a package-tree manifest.
ensure-run installed a missing SDK and resumed the original SDK arguments from the target cwd.
A mismatched SHA-256 returned hash_mismatch and created no install tree.
The explicit registry lane returned registry_integrity_unavailable before network installation.
Inline private-key material was rejected before SDK execution; only a local key path is accepted.

The bundled artifact installed, scored a portable Git-backed Machine-L2 fixture, stamped SDK version, scorer-policy SHA-256, and same-principal independence, then passed offline evidence-hash plus AAR signature verification.
A third-party disclosure without explicit subject/principal DIDs was rejected, and a receipt naming the verifier DID as subject was also rejected before signing.

claim_boundary: These results prove the local static audit/bootstrap/signature path and an integrity-only bundled trust chain. They do not prove publisher authenticity, Machine-L3, or organizational verifier independence; the default receipt discloses same_principal and six live conformance checks remain NOT_RUN.
